column1: # Target: 4 MB flash (ESP-WROOM-32) with dual OTA app slots.
#   otadata    8 KB   which OTA slot to boot
#   ota_0    1.5 MB   app slot A (the app boots here when otadata is blank)
#   ota_1    1.5 MB   app slot B (OTA target)
# App slots must start on a 0x10000 boundary. Total = 0x400000 (4 MB).
